title: Iris
description: 150 iris flowers, four measurements, three species. The canonical classification and clustering dataset.
license: BSD-3-Clause (scikit-learn distribution); original UCI Iris dataset

title: Wine
description: 178 wine samples, 13 chemical measurements, three cultivars. Useful for trees, scaling and multiclass evaluation.
license: BSD-3-Clause (scikit-learn distribution); original UCI Wine dataset

title: Breast Cancer Wisconsin
description: 569 diagnostic records, 30 numeric features, binary diagnosis. A canonical binary-classification and PCA dataset.
license: BSD-3-Clause (scikit-learn distribution); original UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin dataset

title: Diabetes progression
description: 442 patients, ten baseline variables, one-year disease progression target. A canonical regression dataset.
license: BSD-3-Clause (scikit-learn distribution); original source: UCI / Efron et al. diabetes study
